##### Project general facts

The Heart of Europe - Portofino is a magnificent five-star, family-only hotel destination that transports guests to the stunning Italian Riviera, designed by Italian architects and surrounded by glistening turquoise oceans. This architectural marvel features contemporary Mediterranean design with spacious sea view suites and rooftop villas featuring private plunge pools, all exuding Italian style with modern, contemporary flair. Every space has been thoughtfully designed using ancient Feng Shui practices, creating a calming and inviting energy that promises a more than royal welcome from the attentive Italian staff.

The destination boasts an extraordinary array of amenities including five breathtaking swimming pools, with an Olympic pool featuring awe-inspiring live performances and water ballet. Families will delight in the Kingdom of Portofino Kid's Club with its magical snow plaza for building snowmen and creating snow angels, while over five hundred aquariums showcase the remarkable marine life of UAE waters. The Marine Life Science Centre offers educational experiences about coral conservation, while the luxurious women-only spa, La Donna, provides a rejuvenating retreat where mothers can unwind in complete bliss overlooking the stunning Dubai skyline.

Every residence features the finest finishings with Italian architectural design, creating spaces that exude timeless elegance and contemporary comfort. The thoughtfully designed suites include unique 'mini' suites within them just for children, which can be closed off so they can have their own private adventures while parents enjoy peace and quiet. The Villa Adriana presidential suite offers private rooftop infinity pools, Italian designed courtyards, and an abundance of entertainment areas for a stay that takes luxury to an extraordinary new level.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious destination is situated on The World Islands, a remarkable man-made archipelago off the coast of Dubai featuring small islands shaped like a world map representing different countries and regions. The islands are designed to offer luxurious and exclusive living experiences, making them a symbol of opulence and grandeur in the Arabian Gulf. This extraordinary location provides a secluded paradise where privacy, tranquility, and luxury converge in perfect harmony.

The islands offer an elite retreat with lavish villas, mansions, and private estates that boast luxurious amenities and panoramic views of the pristine Arabian Gulf waters. Residents and guests can enjoy access to pristine beaches and breathtaking ocean vistas that create an unparalleled living experience. The development provides a truly exclusive sanctuary away from the bustle of the mainland.

The destination features high-end resorts, boutique hotels, and world-class entertainment facilities that cater to every desire. Guests can indulge in exceptional dining experiences, rejuvenating spa treatments, and a variety of water sports and leisure activities. This distinguished location represents the ultimate expression of luxury island living, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of the world's most extraordinary and prestigious destinations.
